import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing Sleep Disorder values
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder', inplace=True)

# Split Blood Pressure into Systolic and Diastolic columns
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)
df.drop('Blood Pressure', axis=1, inplace=True)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set up the plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Sleep Health Metrics', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level, colored by Sleep Disorder
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    style='BMI Category',
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Stress Level vs. Sleep Duration', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Metrics')

# Plot 2: Quality of Sleep by Occupation
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Occupation',
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    dodge=False,
    palette="plasma"
)
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    color=".25",
    alpha=0.7
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Quality of Sleep by Occupation', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].get_legend().remove()


# Plot 3: Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
numerical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['number']).drop('Person ID', axis=1)
corr = numerical_cols.corr()
mask = pd.np.triu(pd.np.ones_like(corr, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(
    corr,
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    annot=True,
    fmt=".2f",
    cmap='coolwarm',
    linewidths=.5,
    mask=mask
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)


# Plot 4: Count of Sleep Disorders by BMI Category
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    palette='rocket',
    edgecolor='black'
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Disorder Cases by BMI Category', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
for p in axes[1, 1].patches:
    axes[1, 1].annotate(f'{int(p.get_height())}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='white', xytext=(0, -10),
                        textcoords='offset points', weight='bold')


# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
